name: Because You Watched
description: Real 'Because You Watched' recommendations. Replaces Jellyfin's broken recommendations row with similarity-scored picks built from what you actually watched, using Jellyfin's own working similarity engine. Blends recent watches, hides watched items, and backfills thin results. Renders through the Home Screen Sections plugin.
overview: Recommendations that actually match what you watched.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Real similarity-based row, multi-seed blending, watched filtering, same-genre backfill.
